q1_issues.issue: The consequent is never tied to the trigger occurrence — there is no During link back to the sheltering event, and the consequent Skolems are functions of the cove and the member ($cv, $y) rather than of the trigger event, so the whenever template's per-occurrence tie is missing.

The continuation-copular 'stay lit' emits only the reified state (Member/Experiencer/Still) and omits the required flat half — the per-member rule's conclusion has no (Member $y lit), so 'is that lantern lit?' does not bind.

q2_gaps: 'through <period>' as a temporal extent ('stay lit through winter') — During is licensed for during/while/throughout only, Time records a point or named time rather than an extent, and no duration figure is stated, so the 'throughout' force of 'through' has no carrier

a per-member distribution Implication nested inside another rule's CONCLUSION — the instruction set places such rules at top level or inside a seal and never addresses a rule appearing as a conjunct of a derived consequent
notes: Compound genus, Agent/Theme on the stative inanimate transitive 'shelters', LocatedIn for entity-attached containment, the definite-plural group witness, and 'lit' kept as a participial adjective are all correct. The two issues are both omissions of prescribed atoms rather than wrong content.
